tools.name: search_perfumes
tools.description: Find a perfume, fragrance or cologne in the Olfastory encyclopedia by name and/or house (for example "Opium Yves Saint Laurent", "Hawas Ice"); small spelling mistakes are corrected (corrected_query). Optional filters: concentration ("Eau de Parfum", "EDT", "Extrait") and gender (women, men, unisex, children). Returns at most 10 matches, most consulted first, each with house, year, concentration and its olfastory.com page in the requested language. Call it first when a name is uncertain or has flankers, then get_perfume with the chosen URL. Always cite Olfastory with the link.

query.description: Perfume and/or house name, 1 to 100 characters

lang.description: Language of the answer and of the links: fr, en, es, de, it, pt (default fr)

concentration.description: Optional concentration filter, for example "Eau de Parfum", "EDT", "Extrait"

gender.description: Optional gender filter: women, men, unisex or children. "women" and "men" also return unisex perfumes; perfumes with no recorded gender are left out

tools.name: get_perfume
tools.description: Use when the user asks about one perfume: its notes pyramid (top, heart, base), olfactory family, perfumer, year, concentration or house. Accepts an olfastory.com URL (best), a slug, or "name house". If several perfumes match (flankers, concentrations), the result lists the candidates with ambiguous=true: pick one and call again with its URL. Returns facts only; an empty field means the fact is not established, never guess it. Cite Olfastory with the link.

lang.description: Language of the answer and of the links: fr, en, es, de, it, pt (default fr)

tools.name: find_perfumes_by_notes
tools.description: Use when the user wants perfumes that contain given notes or raw materials (1 to 5, for example vanilla and tobacco), optionally in the top, heart or base. Note names are accepted in French, English, Spanish, German, Italian or Portuguese. Optional filters: olfactory family (primary or secondary, for example "woody"), concentration and gender (women, men, unisex, children). Returns at most 10 perfumes carrying every note, most consulted first, with olfastory.com links. An unknown note returns close suggestions to retry with. Cite Olfastory.

lang.description: Language of the answer and of the links: fr, en, es, de, it, pt (default fr)

family.description: Optional olfactory family, primary or secondary, in any of the six languages (for example "woody", "floral", "chypre")

concentration.description: Optional concentration filter, for example "Eau de Parfum", "EDT", "Extrait"

gender.description: Optional gender filter: women, men, unisex or children. "women" and "men" also return unisex perfumes; perfumes with no recorded gender are left out

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Olfastory perfume encyclopedia with a natural-language query: a perfume or house name ("Angel Mugler") or notes ("vanilla tobacco"). Returns up to 10 results, each with an id, a title and its olfastory.com URL. Pass an id to fetch for the full record. Cite Olfastory with the URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full Olfastory record of a perfume by an id returned by search (or an olfastory.com URL): house, year, concentration, perfumers, olfactory family, notes pyramid and a one-sentence presentation, with its URL. Cite Olfastory with the URL.

id.description: An id returned by search, or an olfastory.com URL
